score_weights.name: event_match
score_weights.desc: Classifier confidence that the headline maps to a known event type (rule hits + boosts; Claude-confirmed when enabled).

score_weights.name: historical_edge
score_weights.desc: Strength of the backtested reaction for this event type: direction consistency and t-statistic at the optimal window, shrunk by sample size.

score_weights.name: source_credibility
score_weights.desc: Static weight per publisher. Reuters/Bloomberg/official releases 95–99, major outlets 80–92, aggregators/blogs 45–65, unknown 50.

score_weights.name: novelty
score_weights.desc: Articles about the same event (same type, and same company where relevant, within 24h) are clustered into one signal. A type that already fired in the previous 7 days scores −25 per prior cluster (floor 20), so ongoing stories rank below fresh shocks.

score_weights.name: geo_scope
score_weights.desc: Economic scale of the affected geography: US/China/global 95–100, EU 85, UK 65, single EM 55.
